messages:
maya: Quick update from the int4 onboard run on staging (v3 -> v3q-int4-shadow). Ran 25k requests with a heavy numeric/code mix.
aj: TL;DR? any obvious regressions?
maya: Latency okay. p50 ~ 110ms, p95 ~ 420ms. Two concerns: 1) numeric-span exact-match dropped ~2.3% on financial-report slices. 2) code-block tokenization/verbatim fidelity down for snippets with lots of indentation.
sam: Ouch on financials. Is this consistent across seeds/samples or bursty?
maya: Pretty consistent. We see token-level rounding errors where decimal alignment shifts across tokens -> downstream rerank score drops. Not just noise.
li: Did you try the channel-wise quant buffer (the new kv-widening flag)? That helped in previous runs.
maya: Tried both kv-widening and hybrid-cache. kv-widening recovered ~0.6% of the MRR loss, hybrid-cache negligible. Still ~1.7% net hit on that slice.
eva: Any change in embedding-based concordance for retrieval prompts? cosine delta?
maya: Embedding cosine (doc->query) slightly lower on avg: -0.018 relative. But most of the visible customer impact is in exact numeric spans, not retrieval ranking.
aj: Given that, what gate do you recommend? Full rollback, holdback slices, or phased traffic with circuit-breaker?
maya: Recommend a slice-aware progressive rollout: start at 5% global traffic, double every 2h (5->10->20) but hold back "financial-report" and "code-snippet-heavy" slices initially. Add automatic circuit-breakers: (A) if numeric-exact-match drops >1.0% on any watch slice over 30m -> immediate fallback, (B) if embedding cosine drops >0.02 on a retention slice sustained for 45m -> shadow-only for that slice.
sam: Need hysteresis to avoid flip-flopping on noisy signals. Suggest require 2 consecutive 15m windows for the numeric rule and 3 consecutive 15m for embeddings.
li: Also shadow 3% of held back slices so we can collect token alignment telemetry without impacting users.
maya: Agreed. Draft rollout config I pushed to console below:
```
rollout:
  baseline: v3
  variant: v3q-int4
  traffic_schedule: [0.05, 0.10, 0.20]
  step_interval: 7200  # seconds
  holdback_slices:
    - financial-report
    - code-snippet-heavy
  shadow_percentage_on_holdback: 0.03
  circuit_breakers:
    - id: numeric_exact_match_drop
      metric: numeric_exact_match
      threshold: -0.01
      detection_window: 1800
      required_buckets: 2
      action: immediate-fallback
    - id: embedding_cosine_fall
      metric: embedding_cosine
      threshold: -0.02
      detection_window: 2700
      required_buckets: 3
      action: slice-shadow
```
ops-bot: scheduling rollout: v3q-int4 -> 5% (holdbacks applied). dashboard: https://console.redwood/s/rollouts/1788882000
aj: Add alerting: page if numeric_exact_match_drop trips, and an informational slack thread if shadow telemetry shows token alignment mismatch >0.5%.
eva: I'll wire up a synthetic harness to emit per-token diff histograms every 10m and push to the eval bucket.
li: I'll also add a short-run fuzzer to mutate numeric tokens to check fragility and correlate with rerank delta.
maya: Thanks. Plan to watch first 6h and reconvene with 2h snapshots. If circuit-breaker trips, ops-bot should flip traffic back and create a rollback incident.
sam: Perfect. Keep the run short and conservative. ping me if the financial slice MRR crosses the -1% threshold.
maya: Will do. :white_check_mark:
